text:
nora: FYI production embed-service errors climbing for long-run requests, seen in eu-west1. Need hotfix + expedited signoff.
deploybot: [DeployBot] action=prepare_deploy service=embed-service image=embed-svc:3.2.2-hotfix-20260324 canary=true priority=urgent
liam: link to spike: https://dash.redwood/alerts/embeds/evt-7765 00 errors/min. Repro locally on long-stream test.
cass: root cause looks like race in kv-cache refill after eviction, NPE on warm paths. Patch ready in branch hotfix/kv-warm-fix.
nora: rollback target set to embed-svc:3.2.1 (stable). Manual rollback allowed; prefer auto rollback if customer errors > 1% for 3m.
emily: oncall here. I can run preflight e2e and short load test in 12m. Will monitor p50/95 & error percent.
srebot: [SREBot] suggest keep canary to 5% for initial 15m due to customer impact. Add read-only canary checks for long requests.
liam: propose rollout: 5% -> 15m -> 25% -> 10m -> 100% if green. Pin canary to hotfix tag for 45m before promotion.
deplybot: [DeployBot] requesting approvals from @liam @cass @emily 00 react with :white_check_mark: to grant expedited rollout.
liam: 705 approve. Agree with 5% start and 1% rollback threshold.
cass: 705 approve, patch lgtm and unit tests pass.
emily: 705 approve from oncall, will instrument extra alerts for token timeouts.
deplybot: [DeployBot] starting canary at 5% now. operator=nora canary_id=cb-1747777777
liam: noticed transient spikes in first 2 minutes, looks like cache warming, expected.
srebot: [SREBot] hooking synthetic long-request probe to canary endpoints.
emily: smoke tests passed for basic flows; long-run probe has one retry failure but not sustained.
deplybot: [DeployBot] promoted to 25% (phase=promote) 00 next check after 10m.
nora: bumping monitoring window; adding kill-switch: if error_rate > 0.8% for any 5m or p95 latency +150ms, run rollback.
liam: logs: https://logs.redwood/streams/embeds/evt-7765/trace-42 - stack shows NPE at kv/cache.go:212 fixed by patch.
emily: no customer complaints in support channel yet.
deplybot: [DeployBot] promoting to 100% at 1747777888 00 rollout complete. No auto-rollback triggered.
nora: leaving 45m post-rollout window open per policy. I will update ticket TKT-9987 with timeline and notes.
cass: I'll publish the release note and include the rollback runbook + patch link.
liam: thanks team. closing unless alerts fire.
